## Verdict
needs-revision

## Concerns
- claim-1 is validated but concerns a different paper and does not support the requested certificate.
- claim-2 is unsupported. No full-text artifact, DOI-bearing bibliographic page, stable artifact identifier, cryptographic digest, indexed passages, or exhaustive search witness was supplied.
- Consequently, none of the certificate’s affirmative source-ingestion criteria is established.

## Unresolved certificates
- [proof-attempt] Ingest the complete DOI-specific artifact and provide its stable identifier and cryptographic digest; exact page-and-line-indexed passages for the complete main theorem, coefficient-ring hypotheses, definitions of \(J_v\) and \(A_+\), and every formulation of \(J_v/A_+J_v\); and a reproducible exhaustive search index for all required terms and equivalent notation.
